final_message: Fixed the three PJR-Y3XS issues. 1) Schedule-task integration now also takes the project lifecycle lock (`withExecLifecycleMutex`), so it waits for an in-progress `register ... --commit` instead of failing on its staged files. 2) `register` `-m` is repeatable and the values are joined as paragraphs like `git commit -m`; previously commander kept only the last `-m` (the body), commitlint rejected it, and the failure message ended with an argument fragment. A failed commit now lists the written-but-uncommitted files and exits 1, and git argument summaries are folded onto one line. 3) After a pathspec (`--only`) commit, `restoreIndexAfterPathspecCommit` resets index entries the hook's `stage_fixed` left behind; it runs in both `register ... --commit` and `specdojo git -- commit ... -- <pathspec>`. Added unit and integration tests, updated command-reference and register-operation-guide, and wrote causes, decisions, verification and CHANGELOG draft lines in the ticket's 対応結果. Nothing was run locally: the parent runs typecheck/lint/tests, and the sandbox blocked an ad-hoc Git reproduction, so cause 3 is inferred from Git behavior and confirmed only by the new integration tests.
handoff: Decision: integration vs register-commit contention is resolved by waiting (schedule integration takes the same exec-lifecycle CrossProcessMutex as `register ... --commit` / `specdojo git` / register worktree runs), not by excluding the register files from the integration check.

Not covered: job-mode integration (`src/exec/run/job.ts`) and manual `exec worktree merge` still do not take the cross-process lifecycle lock; apply `withExecLifecycleMutex` in a separate item if the same symptom appears there.

Not covered: a separate `specdojo git -- add` followed later by `specdojo git -- commit` leaves staged files unlocked in between; recommend recording via `register ... --commit` or a single pathspec `specdojo git -- commit`.
`specdojo git` index restoration applies only to `commit ... -- <pathspec>` (with `--`); `git commit <path>` without `--` is not detected.
No protected configuration changes (`lefthook.yml`, `package.json`) were needed.
CHANGELOG draft lines (不具合修正 x3) are in the ticket's `### 5.5. CHANGELOG に書く事項`; `CHANGELOG.md` was not changed.
